Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the task by shifting from “second overall pick in the 1999 MLB Draft” to “the second pick made by the New York Yankees,” conflating the organization that includes the most-titled team (MLB with the Yankees) with that team’s own draft selections. This scope error would have led to identifying the Yankees’ second selection rather than the true target: the overall No. 2 pick in the 1999 MLB Draft.
